VI.description: One iteration of the server loop\2C first half\3A looks at the shared target. Loop Flags says what is due\3B Track Popups lists the LabVIEW popups (Win32 only) and Track Windows the application's other windows (leaving out the windows of other shares)\3B a modal window or a disabled panel window counts as modal\2C modal or a popup as busy (no VI Server call then). Apply Splitter sets a bar a client dropped\2C Refresh Geometry refreshes the cached geometry\2C handle and origin when due\2C and after a refresh or a moved bar Read Panel Info reads the tip strips and splitter bars again. Returns the state with those updated and what it found (track) for Serve Clients Step.
